items.title: Tenuo – Capability-Based Authorization (Macaroons for AI Agents)
items.raw_excerpt: I've been working on a different authorization model for AI agents, motivated by a simple problem: once agents start delegating work to other agents, identity-based permissions and prompt guardrails break down fast. Tenuo makes authority task-scoped. A manager agent starts with a signed capability ("warrant") and can delegate to workers, but delegation can only attenuate. Each step gets narrower authority, and it disappears when the task ends. Even if an agent is prompt-injected, it can't take actions outside its warrant. Every tool call requires proof-of-possession, and arguments are validated against explicit constraints before execution. This is inspired by systems like Macaroons / Biscuit / UCAN, but adapted for AI agents processing untrusted input: - signed, ephemeral capability token

items.raw_excerpt: 2月3日，以“AI时代的工作方式”为主题的钉峰会在北京隆重举行。雷峰网获悉，峰会由阿里巴巴钉钉和中关村国际共同举办，汇聚了来自制造业、农业、供应链、环保、文媒等多行业的领军企业代表、数字化先锋及专家逾三百人，深入探讨人工智能浪潮下工作方式的重塑与进化。 现场，一批北京区域企业与钉钉集中签约，共同迈入AI时代的工作方式，包括博锐尚格科技股份有限公司、天津市神州商龙科技股份有限公司、北京健坤餐饮集团、北京央视瑞安技术服务有限公司等。 智能体操作系统：从工具到伙伴的进化 钉钉华北大区总经理刘浩在致辞中指出，当前正处在AI转型的关键时间点。钉钉以解决真实问题为原点，致力于从传统的应用平台升级为面向未来的“智能体操作系统”（Agent OS）。他强调，AI时代的工作方式需要根本性的重新思考，即从“人操作工具”转向“人调教AI”，让智能体（Agent）成为业务执行与协同的核心单元。 钉钉华北大区总经理刘浩 中关村国际控股有限公司总经理卢江表示，中关村国际正通过覆盖全球的创新网络，携手钉钉，以AI为纽带、出海服务为桥梁，共同优化AI时代的服务模式，让创新价值在全球范围内绽放。 钉钉华北大区解决方案总经理刘啸天在主题分享中阐释了“智能体协同”的核心逻辑。他认为，AI规模化落地的关键瓶颈不再是模型能力，而在于缺乏企业级统一的运行环境。钉钉正以Agent OS为内核，构建下一代操作系统，通过智能体统一调度数字工具与物理设备，并实现智能体间的交互与协同。人在这一系统中的角色，从执行者转变为“教练”，负责调教与设定目标，而将重复性、流程化的工作交由智能体执行。 全网爆火的钉钉首款AI硬件DingTalk A1录音卡也在本次峰会上亮相，A1产品负责人夏治朋详细介绍了这款“网红”产品设计的初衷和用户自发探索出的花式用法，现场种草。 跨界实践：AI赋能千行百业，客户亲述转型心声 峰会邀请了多位来自一线企

On February 3, the DingTalk Summit themed "Work Styles in the AI Era" was grandly held in Beijing. According to Leifeng.com, the summit was jointly organized by Alibaba's DingTalk and Zhongguancun International, bringing together over 300 representatives from leading enterprises, digital pioneers, and experts across various industries such as manufacturing, agriculture, supply chain, environmental protection, and culture and media. They engaged in in-depth discussions on the reshaping and evolution of work styles under the wave of artificial intelligence.  

At the event, a group of Beijing-based companies signed centralized agreements with DingTalk to jointly embrace AI-era work styles. These companies included Borui Shangge Technology Co., Ltd., Tianjin Shenzhou Shanglong Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing Jiankun Catering Group, and Beijing CCTV Ruian Technical Service Co., Ltd.  

**Intelligent Agent Operating System: Evolution from Tool to Partner**  
Liu Hao, General Manager of DingTalk's North China Region, emphasized in his speech that the current moment is a critical juncture for AI transformation. DingTalk, starting from solving real-world problems, is committed to upgrading from a traditional application platform to a future-oriented "Intelligent Agent Operating System" (Agent OS). He stressed that work styles in the AI era require fundamental rethinking—shifting from "humans operating tools" to "humans training AI," making intelligent agents the core units for business execution and collaboration.  

Lu Jiang, General Manager of Zhongguancun International Holding Co., Ltd., stated that Zhongguancun International, through its global innovation network, is collaborating with DingTalk to optimize service models in the AI era, using AI as a link and overseas services as a bridge to unleash the value of innovation worldwide.
